label: ITS
description: GIC ITS (Interrupt Translation Service) 寄存器

registers.name: GITS_TYPER
registers.description: ITS Type Register。GIC ITS 寄存器。

fields.name: RES0
fields.description: 保留，RES0。

fields.name: INV
fields.description: ITS cache invalidation behavior on disable. If GITS_TYPER.INV is 1, after the following sequence: There is no cached information from the ITS memory structure pointed to by GITS_BASER<n>. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: UMSIirq
fields.description: Indicates support for generating an interrupt on receiving unmapped MSI. If GITS_TYPER.UMSI is 0, this field is RES0. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: UMSI
fields.description: Indicates support for reporting receipt of unmapped MSIs. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: nID
fields.description: [When GICv4.1 is implemented] nID [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: SVPET
fields.description: [When GICv4.1 is implemented] SVPET [0b00=; 0b01=; 0b10=; 0b11=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: VMAPP
fields.description: [When GICv4.1 is implemented] VMAPP [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: VSGI
fields.description: [When GICv4.1 is implemented] VSGI [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: MPAM
fields.description: [When GICv3.1 is implemented] MPAM [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: VMOVP
fields.description: [When GICv4 is implemented] Indicates the form of the VMOVP command. [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: CIL
fields.description: Collection ID Limit. In implementations that do not support Collections in external memory, this bit is RES0 and the number of Collections supported is reported by GITS_TYPER.HCC. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: CIDbits
fields.description: Number of Collection ID bits. This field has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED value.

fields.name: HCC
fields.description: Hardware Collection Count. The number of interrupt collections supported by the ITS without provisioning of external memory. Collections held in hardware are unmapped at reset. This field has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED value.

fields.name: RES0
fields.description: 保留，RES0。

fields.name: PTA
fields.description: Physical Target Addresses. Indicates the format of the target address: For more information, see 'RDbase' in ARM® Generic Interrupt Controller Architecture Specification, GIC architecture version 3.0 and version 4.0 (ARM IHI 0069). [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: SEIS
fields.description: SEI support. Indicates whether the ITS supports generation of SEIs: [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: Devbits
fields.description: The number of DeviceID 位数 implemented, minus one. This field has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED value.

fields.name: ID_bits
fields.description: The number of EventID 位数 implemented, minus one. This field has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED value.

fields.name: ITT_entry_size
fields.description: Read-only. Indicates the number of bytes per translation table entry, minus one. For more information about the ITS command 'MAPD', see MAPD. This field has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED value.

fields.name: IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED
fields.description: IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED.

fields.name: CCT
fields.description: Cumulative Collection Tables. If GITS_TYPER.HCC == 0, or if memory backed collections are not supported (all GITS_BASER<n>.Type != 100), this bit is RES0. [0b0=; 0b1=]

fields.name: Virtual
fields.description: [When GICv4 is implemented] Indicates whether the ITS supports virtual LPIs and direct injection of virtual LPIs: [0b0=; 0b1=]；否则为 RES0

fields.name: Physical
fields.description: Indicates whether the ITS supports 物理 LPIs: This field is RES1, indicating that the ITS supports 物理 LPIs. [0b0=; 0b1=]
